audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers give opposite verdicts on all seven stages — full-layer phases[N].side reads Vex 7/7 with diff HARD 8/10, content win[N] reads LeBlanc 7/7 — and within the full layer every side said Vex while every why described LeBlanc winning.
audit.why: The kit explains why this lane is hard: Doom 'n Gloom fears AND interrupts dashes, and every dash near her leaves a mark that shortens its next charge. LeBlanc's entire pattern is dash-in, dash-back — she is the champion the passive was written against. 47.05% over 2952 games agrees. But packet.levelChart says LeBlanc 7/7, and the packet flags its own chart as contradicting that win rate.
audit.corrected: I made the FULL layer internally coherent — every why now argues the Vex verdict its side already claimed — and left both charts' sides untouched. The cross-layer split is escalated rather than guessed at.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were keyed to Vex's ultimate as though it were her defining tool, and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Her lane power is the passive and Mistral Bolt, not Shadow Surge. Mistral Bolt is 1200 range on 8/7/6/5/4 against your 700 Q; Personal Space is a 16/15/14/13/12 shield; Shadow Surge is 140/120/100 and reaches 2000/2500/3000.
audit.corrected: Spikes keyed to Mistral Bolt's shrinking cooldown, Personal Space's 16-second shield, and Shadow Surge at 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page labelled Personal Space as the fear — 'Personal Space (Fear)' — across focus.text, winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.feeding and three report entries. It is a shield.
audit.why: Riot text for W: 'Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies.' The fear is Doom 'n Gloom, the passive: 'Vex periodically becomes empowered, causing her next basic Ability to fear enemies and interrupt dashes. Whenever a nearby enemy dashes, Vex applies a mark that can be consumed for bonus damage that also reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.' So the whole page told the player to track the wrong ability, and the interrupt-plus-mark loop — the single most important thing in this matchup for a dash champion — appeared nowhere.
audit.corrected: Doom 'n Gloom named as the fear that interrupts dashes and gets its cooldown shortened by your dashes; Personal Space named as a 16-second shield that must be forced out before your burst opener.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three invented mechanics in the content layer: 'Chaos Orb', a 'Doom execute', and a 'Done in a Flash execute'. Plus mid called Shadow Surge 'her only real escape'.
audit.why: Chaos Orb is not a LeBlanc ability. Vex has no execute in her kit text — her R is 'Fire a missile that marks an enemy champion. Recast to dash to them and deal damage', which dashes her TOWARD a target, so it is engage, not escape. 'Done in a Flash' is not in her kit at all.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real tools and the real direction of travel.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries the real numbers.
audit.corrected: Personal Space 16s at rank 1, Shadow Surge 140s at rank 1, Mistral Bolt 8s falling to 4s.

notes: THE BIG ONE, AND I DID NOT GUESS AT IT — see questionsForUser. This matchup's two layers give opposite verdicts on all seven stages: full-layer phases[N].side reads Vex 7/7 with diff HARD, diffRating 8/10, carryRating 8.5/10 and a red tone, while content win[N] reads LeBlanc 7/7. packet.levelChart sides with the content layer (LeBlanc 7/7) but packet.defects flags that same chart as contradicting the 47.05% win rate. I did not move a single side or win value. What I DID fix is that the full layer was at war with itself: every phases[N].side said Vex while every phases[N].why described LeBlanc bullying the lane. All seven whys now argue the verdict their own side already claimed, so the full layer is internally coherent and the only remaining split is the cross-layer one I am escalating. Flipping the content layer would mean rewriting seven whys, four spikes and three narrative fields to argue the opposite of what they say now, and I will not invent a seven-stage power shift a player would trust. Second major finding: the page called Personal Space 'the fear' in ten separate fields. It is a shield ('Gain a shield and damage nearby enemies'). The fear is Doom 'n Gloom, the passive, and it does something no field mentioned — it INTERRUPTS DASHES, and every dash a nearby enemy makes leaves a mark that reduces the cooldown of her empowered state. For a champion whose entire pattern is dash-in and dash-back, that loop is the matchup, and it was absent. It is now in breakdown.cooldowns, breakdown.trading, both dos and donts, three report entries, spikes[3] and late. The missingInteractions shield rule is covered in spikes[2].text, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns. Three fabrications killed: 'Chaos Orb' (not a LeBlanc ability, same invention as in the twistedfate and veigar entries), 'Doom execute' and 'Done in a Flash execute' (Vex's kit text contains no execute at all). Also corrected: mid called Shadow Surge 'her only real escape' — it marks an enemy and dashes her TOWARD them, so it is engage, not escape. PACKET SUSPECTNAME FALSE POSITIVE: wants.foe[2] 'Use Shadow Surge to close distance or peel' was flagged; the name is correct and I left it. phases[N].rating left alone throughout.
